name: devagent
description: Drives 58 slash commands over a 24-step issue workflow, preserving all state on disk so you can switch issues without losing context. Works against GitHub/GitLab/JIRA, with capture + issue red-team, revision, WBS, and status-report subsystems.

devdoc_root.title: devDoc root
devdoc_root.description: Directory for devAgent's per-issue devdoc artifacts. SEEDS the /devagent:init interview at enable time; config.toml wins thereafter (the single source of truth).

default_project.title: Default project
default_project.description: Default project name to offer when /devagent:init is run without an argument. Seed only; config.toml's [project.<name>] blocks remain authoritative.
